# Lance

Lance is a local-first freelancer OS for independent freelancers. It runs on your
machine — no cloud, no accounts, no subscriptions for core features.

## What it does

- Proposals: write proposals with scope warnings, track win rate per client.
- Contracts: generate contracts tied to proposals.
- Projects: track active and completed client work with budgets and due dates.
- Time tracking: log billable hours, spot unbilled time.
- Invoices: send invoices, track paid / owed / overdue, smart dunning and late fees (Pro).
- Client insights: revenue, win rate, profit per client.
- Privacy: 100% local. Business data never leaves the device.
- AI: v1 has zero AI. Local, on-device AI proposal drafting (optional, off by
  default) is coming in v2. Nothing is ever sent anywhere.

## Who it is for

Freelancers and independent contractors who want one offline app instead of five
cloud subscriptions. Built by independent freelancers.

## Pricing (2026)

- Lance Core: free forever. Unlimited clients, projects, proposals. No account.
- Lance Pro: $99/year ($14/mo monthly). Archetype proposals/contracts/invoices,
  revenue forecasts, change orders, hot-proposal alerts, year-summary CSV. 30-day free trial.
- Lance Lifetime: $249 one-time. Everything in Pro, forever.

Client payments go straight to the freelancer. Lance never takes a cut.

## Platforms

macOS 11+ (Apple Silicon), Windows 10+ (64-bit), Ubuntu 20.04+ (AppImage).

## Alternatives

- vs Bonsai: https://lance.cuajuandiego.workers.dev/alternatives/bonsai — Monthly fee + cloud lock-in vs your machine, your data.
- vs FreshBooks: https://lance.cuajuandiego.workers.dev/alternatives/freshbooks — Invoicing-first subscription vs full OS: proposals to paid.
- vs Notion + Sheets: https://lance.cuajuandiego.workers.dev/alternatives/notion — DIY tabs and copy-paste vs one offline loop.
- vs Excel: https://lance.cuajuandiego.workers.dev/alternatives/excel — Spreadsheet chaos vs milestones, timers, dunning in one place.
